newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch finance ministry sets new DTC programme.
newsitem.headline: Dutch finance ministry sets new DTC programme.

text.p: The Dutch finance ministry said on Monday it was opening a new Dutch Treasury Certificate (DTC) programme with a maximum issue amount of 7.5 billion guilders.
The programme, which matures on July 31, is currently priced at 3.14 percent.
Including the new programme, the ministry now has three 7.5 billion guilder short-term borrowing programmes in issue, maturing on June 30, July 31 and December 31 respectively.
Another DTC programme totalling 7.5 billion guilders maturing on May 30 has already been fully subscribed.
As of May 2, the ministry had received 7.5 billion guilders under the May programme, 5.299 billion under the June programme, and 4.905 billion under the December programme.
A ministry spokesman said on Monday there had already been a number of subscribers to the new programme, who had paid 3.14 percent.
